scripts.dev:backend: uv run --project apps/backend uvicorn advx_backend.main:app --app-dir apps/backend/src --reload --port 8765
scripts.test: node --test scripts/process-lifecycle.test.mjs && pnpm --filter @advx/desktop test && uv run --project apps/backend pytest apps/backend/tests
scripts.contracts: uv run --project apps/backend python apps/backend/scripts/export_openapi.py && pnpm exec openapi-typescript apps/backend/openapi.json -o packages/contracts/src/generated/openapi.ts
